name: Build Satellite Tower
placementTarget: Back of each player reference card, with the Transmit strip. The instruction sticker says to place it there.
text:
BUILD SATELLITE TOWER
Spend 2 Supply cubes to build a satellite tower in your city.

[satellite-dish icon]

mechanics.timing: Action, on your turn, in a city.
mechanics.effect: Spend 2 Supply cubes to build a satellite tower in your city.
restrictions: This strip is the short action reminder. The full rule, including paying from your Character card and moving an existing tower when none are left, is Rule O.
The Kinshasa Technician search reduces this cost by 1 Supply cube while that card is in hand.
